name: What is the difference between a pre-hung door frame and a slab door frame?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a pre-hung door frame and a slab door frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pre-hung door frame is a complete unit that includes the door slab, the frame, hinges, and often the threshold, all pre-assembled. This makes installation generally quicker and simpler as the door is already fitted to its frame. A slab door frame, in contrast, refers only to the door itself, without a frame or hinges. When using a slab door, the frame must be purchased or constructed separately, and the door needs to be mortised for hinges and drilled for hardware on-site. Pre-hung units are typically preferred for new installations or when replacing both the door and frame, while slab doors are often used to replace a door within an existing, well-maintained frame.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pre-hung door frame includes the door, frame, and hardware pre-assembled, simplifying installation. A slab door frame is just the door, requiring a separate frame and on-site hardware installation.
